intent_snapshot.goal: Implement Slice S3 of docs/specs/tri-host-capability-alignment.spec.md: bind Pi verification to the shared VerifierObservation state machine over in-memory typed Agent events while preserving the exact Pi dispatch envelope, packet marker and pre-dispatch parameter guard.

acceptance.assertion: Per D4 of docs/specs/tri-host-capability-alignment.spec.md (source: BR-REQ-6): a real Pi Agent dispatch accepted by the reservation guard maps to start and its observed bytes to result, yielding one receipt through inspectVerification. Positive: exact reserved dispatch and result succeed. Negative: unknown reservation, altered prompt/parameter, duplicate dispatch or conflicting result bytes refuses or remains pending without settling. Bound: only submit_verification consumes the ok inspection. Agreed seams: tests/pi-canary-assurance-progression.test.ts, tests/pi-subagent-dispatch-observability-contract.test.ts.

Per D4 of docs/specs/tri-host-capability-alignment.spec.md (source: BR-REQ-6): Pi supplies terminal=result, actorPrefix=pi and the existing Agent envelope to the same machine used by the other adapters. Positive: cross-Host profiles preserve their receipt behavior. Negative: bad packet handles, missing terminal evidence and consumed receipts keep their refusals. Bound: no second Pi pending-verifier state machine remains. Agreed seams: tests/dual-host-assurance-conformance.test.ts, tests/pi-canary-assurance-advance.test.ts.

Per D5 of docs/specs/tri-host-capability-alignment.spec.md (source: BR-REQ-6): the Pi adapter and its observation tests typecheck after composition, with no change to Pi public tool names or native UI. Positive: typecheck passes. Negative: stale references to the retired map-based machine fail. Bound: no MCP transport is introduced. Agreed seam: TypeScript.

attestations.summary: PiReviewHost now uses the shared VerifierObservation over a MemoryHookEventLog. PI_VERIFIER_PROFILE sets terminal=result and actorPrefix=pi and keeps the exact Agent envelope. The dispatch guard turns an accepted dispatch into a start event and the observed bytes into a result event. Unknown reservations, altered parameters, duplicate dispatches and conflicting bytes are still refused. Inspection does not settle on its own. Cross-host conformance now includes a pi profile. The bundles match the shared source. Blast radius: medium; the load-bearing paths are runtime/host-core/verifier_observation.ts (shared by all three hosts, which only gain two read accessors and a more detailed conflict message) and .pi-extension/pi-canary-assurance-progression.ts.

advisory_findings.summary: The retired Pi map threw 'duplicate verifier reservation' when prepareVerification got a repeated operationId. The shared VerifierObservation.prepare now silently overwrites the pending entry, and no test pins either behavior.

evidence.trigger: PiReviewHost.prepareVerification called twice with the same operationId → the second call replaces the first pending reservation instead of being refused

advisory_findings.summary: onSessionShutdown appends session_end for the constant 'pi-session' id. If the same PiReviewHost is reused after that, the shared endSession can move an unbound reservation's cursor past the cleared log, so a later dispatch is ignored. The reservation then reports 'not observed' and is released rather than wrongly settled.

evidence.trigger: a reservation is prepared but not yet dispatched, onSessionShutdown runs, the same host instance is reused and the dispatch arrives → the start event lands at an index below the moved cursor and inspect refuses with release:true
